headline: Clean: with a Rho-Bank+ subscription, Gold Rewards Card plus Gold Plus Account is the single best net-return combination for $30,000.
solution_check: At least 10-12 withdrawals a month rules out Bronze (6), Green (8; 15 only with EcoCard) and Silver (10; 15 only with the $200 Platinum card). No crypto removes Crypto-Cash Back. A fee under $100 removes Platinum ($200), Diamond ($495) and the $100 business Green Rewards card. $30k is enough for Gold Plus's $25k minimum, but Platinum and above need more. Results: Gold Plus 6.0% + Gold Rewards +0.35% (gold_plus_account_009; $0 fee, available with Rho-Bank+) = 6.35% -> $1,905. Next best: Gold Plus + Bronze Rewards 6.15% -> $1,845, then Gold Plus + Silver Rewards $1,830, then Gold + EcoCard $1,780. The answer is unique and matches the gold; the gold replays cleanly.
prior_note: The prior review also rated this clean; that still holds.
